title: Sonarqube: GitIdentifiers class in Apache Commons Codec did not reject NUL bytes in tree entry names (CVE-2026-124077)
description: CVE-2026-124077 is a medium severity vulnerability affecting Sonarqube related to the GitIdentifiers class in Apache Commons Codec. The issue is that this class did not reject NUL bytes in tree entry names, which could lead to unexpected behavior. The vulnerability has been fixed in versions 26.7.0.124771-r13, 26.8.0.126808-r7, and 2.10.0-r15.
